tools.description:
Search the official SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) documentation (capire) for CAP syntax, APIs, annotations, and configuration — covering CDS (CDL, CQL, CSN), the Node.js runtime (`@sap/cds`), and the Java runtime (`com.sap.cds`).

Returns up to `maxResults` documentation chunks ranked by semantic similarity.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of chunks to return.

query.description: Natural-language question or keyword phrase scoped to a single concept. Ranked by semantic similarity, so a descriptive phrase beats a single word.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search in CAP Documentation

tools.description: Returns CDS model definitions (CSN), including elements, annotations, parameters, file locations and HTTP endpoints. Useful for building queries, OData URLs, or modifying models.

kind.description: Definition kind to filter by (e.g., service, entity, action)

name.description: Definition name (fuzzy search; no regex or special characters)

namesOnly.description: If true, only return definition names (for overview)

tools.name: search_model
tools.title: Search for CDS definitions
